verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs say workflows can be triggered by record changes, schedules, manual actions, or webhooks. Workflows chain no-code steps including record operations, send email, HTTP requests, code, branches and delays. Notification examples include Slack alerts when a deal reaches a stage. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of a 'create task' action (only implied via generic record operations), native in-app or Slack notification steps rather than email/HTTP, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of workflow reliability.
